emptyText: Under Production → Monitoring you add addresses that Hostwerk checks regularly.
pubHint: Visitors can see without signing in whether your services are running – only names, state, availability and history.
noRemote: For a link from outside, switch on remote access (Going live → Remote access) – or place the page into a website below.
rotateHint: New link: the old one stops working.
introPh: e.g. Here you can see whether the shop and the Minecraft server are running.
showUrlsHint: Otherwise visitors only see the names.
whichChecksHint: Unticked = stays private. A display name replaces the internal name.
siteHint: Hostwerk writes index.html and status.json into this folder every minute – for example htdocs/status of your website. That way the page runs on your own web server and domain.
